newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jinro Group to sell soft drinks business.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jinro Group to sell soft drinks business.

text.p: Jinro Group, South Korea's 19th largest industrial conglomerate, said on Monday it would sell can food, soft drinks businesses as part of a plan to raise more than 1.2 trillion won by the end of 1998.
The group, which has Jinro Ltd and 21 other companies as members, will also sell some of its real estate and other assets to improve the group's financial structure, a Jinro statement said.
Jinro plans to sell "unprofitable" businesses, including can food and soft drinks manufacturing, by the end of this year, the statement said.
It said Jinro plans to boost its equity-to-asset ratio to 13 percent by the end of this year and 24.7 percent by 1998 from the current 4.43 percent.
Company officials declined to give further details.
